soil_moisture_pct.source: NASA SMAP SPL3SMP Version 009 (L3 Radiometer Daily 36 km)
soil_moisture_pct.overpass: Ascending / PM pass (~12:22 UTC / 17:52 IST, Orbit 04899_A)
soil_moisture_pct.note: Coarse satellite radiometer estimate (36 km EASE-Grid 2.0). On 2016-01-01, soil moisture was retrieved during the PM ascending pass (~12:22 UTC / 17:52 IST, Orbit 04899_A); the AM descending pass contained no data over South India. Urban core pixels directly over central Bengaluru were flagged (retrieval_qual_flag_pm = 9) and excluded under the strict recommended-quality mask ((retrieval_qual_flag_pm & 7) == 0). All 2,380 1 km grid cells are assigned to the nearest of five valid surrounding 36 km SMAP pixels, with a maximum source distance of 37.91 km. Values represent coarse regional background moisture (8.55% to 13.32%) and carry spatial uncertainty; they do not capture 1 km sub-grid urban heterogeneity. No interpolation, synthetic filling, or invalid substitution was performed.

temperature_min_c.note: Coarse reanalysis estimate (MERRA-2). Each 1 km grid cell is assigned the value of the nearest POWER grid point with a valid measurement. Multiple cells may share the same source value. No interpolation is performed.

temperature_max_c.note: Coarse reanalysis estimate (MERRA-2). Each 1 km grid cell is assigned the value of the nearest POWER grid point with a valid measurement. Multiple cells may share the same source value. No interpolation is performed.

humidity_pct.note: Coarse reanalysis estimate (MERRA-2). Each 1 km grid cell is assigned the value of the nearest POWER grid point with a valid measurement. Multiple cells may share the same source value. No interpolation is performed.

ndvi.source: NASA MODIS Terra MOD13Q1 Version 061 (16-Day L3 Global 250m)
ndvi.native_resolution: 250 m Sinusoidal Grid (~231.66 m x 231.66 m)
ndvi.assignment_method: Centroid 250m pixel sampling, with within-cell 250m pixel mean fallback; null otherwise
ndvi.note: Vegetation index composite from NASA MODIS/Terra MOD13Q1 Collection 6.1 (250m Sinusoidal Grid, tile h25v07). Each 1 km cell was evaluated against quality-screened 250 m pixels requiring pixel_reliability == 0 (Good Data) and (VI_Quality & 0b11) == 0 (VI produced, good quality). Centroid sampling was used where high-quality pixels were present (877 cells); within-cell arithmetic mean of valid interior pixels was used as fallback (416 cells). Cells with no valid quality-screened pixels inside their 1 km boundary remain strictly null (1,087 cells, primarily central urban core with high aerosol/urban surface interference). No pixels outside the cell polygon were used, and no synthetic interpolation was performed.

evapotranspiration_mm.source: NASA MODIS Terra MOD16A2GF Version 061 (8-Day L4 Global 500m)
evapotranspiration_mm.native_resolution: 500 m Sinusoidal Grid (~463.31 m x 463.31 m)
evapotranspiration_mm.temporal_accumulation: 8-day total (not daily ET rate; daily divisor is 8)
evapotranspiration_mm.quality_policy: Documented valid raw range excluding special codes 32761-32767. ET_QC_500m Bit 0 recorded for diagnostics per NASA MOD16 GF user guide.
evapotranspiration_mm.assignment_method: Centroid 500m pixel sampling, with within-cell 500m pixel mean fallback; null otherwise
evapotranspiration_mm.note: 8-day accumulated evapotranspiration from NASA MODIS/Terra MOD16A2GF Collection 6.1 (500m Sinusoidal Grid, tile h25v07, year-end gap-filled science product). Values represent total evapotranspiration in mm accumulated over the 8-day composite period from 2016-01-01 through 2016-01-08 (DOY 001-008); they are NOT single-day rates. To obtain the equivalent mean daily evapotranspiration rate, divide by 8 (daily_rate_divisor: 8). Each 1 km cell was matched against valid 500 m physical retrievals (raw range -32767 to 32700, scale factor 0.1). Centroid sampling was used where valid physical pixels covered the cell center (2,067 cells); within-cell arithmetic mean of valid interior pixels was used as fallback (104 cells). Cells where all interior pixels represent unmodeled surfaces remain strictly null (209 cells, primarily urban/built-up land cover [code 32762] and water bodies [code 32766] where Penman-Monteith does not retrieve transpiration). No spatial interpolation or outside-cell borrowing was performed. Per NASA MOD16 Collection 6.1 guidance, the gap-filled product MOD16A2GF screens input LAI/FPAR climatologically; QC diagnostics at cell centroids record 2,069 primary LAI retrievals and 310 gap-filled LAI retrievals.
